name: Ability_Turret
note: Engineer's deployable gear turret ~2.4 wide x 2.6 tall: steel tripod base, turning head with a brass barrel and gold gears. Origin = ground centre, barrel faces -Y. Head piece spins (Spin) around its own axis.

name: Alchemist
note: Slate long coat over a leather apron, aviator cap with brass goggles, bandolier of glowing flasks, a big flask in hand.

name: Ash_Pile
note: Grey ash heap with charcoal chunks and two tiny embers, ~3 x 2.2 x 0.9. Decoration (no collider).

name: Banner
note: Pole banner ~9 tall: slate-blue cloth with a gold crown (both faces). Front = -Y.

name: Barrel
note: Wooden barrel, 1.6 x 2. Collider circle.

name: Basalt_Column
note: Landmark cluster of hexagonal basalt columns, 2.5 to 9.5 tall, ~7 x 6, with pale tops that read from above. Collider circle.

name: Basalt_Rock
note: Dark basalt boulder with an ash-dusted top, ~4.6 x 2.8. Collider circle.

name: BeetleWarrior
note: Skeleton id. Upright armoured beetle soldier: horned steel helm, spear and shield.

name: BombTick
note: Bomber id. Bloated crimson tick with glowing amber spots that pulse: explosive.

name: Bones
note: Sun-bleached bones of a big beast: horned skull, spine and ribs, ~5 x 2.6. Decoration (no collider).

name: Brazier
note: Iron fire bowl on a stone pedestal, ~2 x 3.6, with a flame. Collider circle.

name: BriarSentinel
note: Boss (BriarBoss). Bramble treant knight ~13 tall: twisted dark bark body and root legs, mossy bramble armour plates, pale bone thorns, bark helm with amber eyes, crown of thorny branches with amber berries, amber heart-knot (Pulse), long root arms (SwingB/A) whose root fingers reach the ground.

name: Brimstone_Altar
note: Landmark brimstone altar ~8.6 wide: two-step octagonal basalt dais with glowing lava channels, four curved obsidian horns, a gold-rimmed fire bowl with a big flame. Front = -Y. Collider = the bowl pedestal and the horns; light = flame.

name: Burrower
note: Digger: ochre mole-cricket with an armoured pronotum and huge shovel claws (Jaw = dig stroke), soft segmented abdomen, a ring of soil clods at its feet (Mound piece, hide it when walking on the surface). ~3.4 wide x 3.6 long x 1.9 tall.

name: Bush
note: Low shrub, 3 x 2. Decoration (no collider).

name: Cactus
note: Saguaro cactus ~4.2 tall with two arms and a crimson bloom. Collider circle.

name: Cactus_Tall
note: Tall saguaro ~7 tall with three arms. Collider circle.

name: Castle_Banner
note: Hanging wall banner 2.6 x 6, crimson with a gold crown. Origin = top centre of the cloth on the wall face; it hangs down (-Z) and stands 0.25 off the wall toward -Y.
anchor: top centre of the cloth, on the wall face

name: Castle_Gate
note: Gatehouse 12 x 13 x 4 with an arched passage (5.2 wide), a raised dark iron portcullis and a warm-lit doorway. Front = -Y.

name: Castle_Tower
note: Round tower, radius ~4.2 (parapet 4.4), 16 tall, crenellated top.

name: Castle_TowerRoof
note: Round tower with a slate cone roof, gold finial and a crimson pennant (~25 tall).

name: Castle_Wall
note: Crenellated wall segment, 12 (X) x 10 x 3, front face = -Y. Tiles every 12 studs.

name: Challenge_Brazier
note: Timed-challenge marker: chamfered stone obelisk on a two-step plinth with a floating gold rune ring and a fire bowl, ~3 x 6.4. Recolour Runes and Flame/FlameCore per state (idle, active, done, failed). Collider circle; light = flame.

name: Challenge_Ring
note: Flat ring of inlaid curved stones marking a 24-stud challenge circle (radius 12 to the stone centre line, 1.1 wide, 0.18 tall) with gold rune ticks and four small Neon markers at the compass points. Walkable decoration (no collider). Recolour Runes / Glow per state.

name: Charred_Tree
note: Dead charred tree ~9 tall with bare forked limbs (reads as a dark star from above) and a few ember glints. Collider = trunk.

name: Chest
note: Elite treasure chest 3 x 2 x 2.1: wooden body (Box), barrel lid (Lid, hinge at the back), iron straps, gold corners and lock. Front (lock) = -Y.

name: Crate
note: Wooden supply crate, 2 x 2 x 2. Collider box.

name: Crystal
note: XP gem: chunky cut gold gem, ~1.0 wide x 1.25 tall at scale 1 (Small gem), centred 0.65 above the origin. Slots: Glow = body (recoloured per gem size), Light = tiny Neon table.

name: CrystalCluster
note: Restrained arcane crystal cluster, ~3 x 3, slate-blue and ivory with a tiny glow.

name: Dais
note: Round two-step stone dais, ~11 diameter. Top surface at 1.2 (extra 'top'); lower step tread at 0.6. Gold inlay ring on the top.

name: Desert_Mesa
note: Landmark mesa: a stepped butte of striped sandstone layers with a flat sand-capped top and fallen boulders, ~13 x 8.5 tall. Collider circle.

name: Desert_Obelisk
note: Landmark sandstone obelisk ~11 tall on a three-step plinth, gold pyramidion and gold glyph columns on every face. Front = -Y. Collider box.

name: Desert_Rock
note: Layered sandstone rock, ~4.4 x 2.8, terracotta and tan bands. Collider circle.

name: Desert_Ruin_Pillar
note: Broken sandstone column on a plinth with a terracotta band and a sand drift, ~2.6 wide, 5.2 tall. Collider circle.

name: Desert_Ruin_Wall
note: Broken sandstone block wall half buried in sand, 8 x 3.4 x 1.4 (length along X), terracotta course. Collider box.

name: Desert_Tent
note: Nomad tent ~6 x 5 x 3.9: striped crimson and ivory cloth on poles, open front (-Y) over a rug, a clay pot and guy ropes. Collider box.

name: Dune
note: Wind-shaped sand dune mound ~9 x 5.5 x 1.5 with a lit crest. Decoration (no collider).

name: EliteAura_Burning
note: Elite aura: a ring of ten low-poly flame licks (fire orange outside, gold inner licks, tiny Neon sparks above) around the body, radius ~1.8, ~1.5 tall. Spin.

name: EliteAura_Shield
note: Elite aura: three translucent steel hex shield plates with gold rims orbiting the body at mid height (radius ~1.9, plates ~1.1 across), a small arcane glint on each. Spin.

name: EliteAura_Swift
note: Elite aura: three pale wind-streak ribbons spiralling around the body at different heights (radius ~1.7-2.0), tapered at both ends, translucent ivory; tiny Neon tips at the leading ends. Spin.

name: Ember_Vent
note: Small basalt fumarole ~2.8 wide, 1.3 tall, with a glowing mouth, a flame lick and an ash ring. Collider circle; light = mouth.

name: Engineer
note: Stout dwarf engineer: steel miner's helmet with a brass lamp, huge ginger beard, boiler backpack, gold gears, giant steel wrench.

name: Fence_Section
note: Weathered post-and-rail fence, 8 long (X) x 2.6 tall. Collider box.

name: Fern
note: Fern rosette, 2.5 x 1.2. Small decoration (no collider, no shadow).

name: Flowers
note: Patch of small ivory flowers with leaves, 1.5 wide (<= 80 tris). Recolour slot Bloom (e.g. gold_300) for pale-gold patches.

name: FrostboundColossus
note: Boss (FrostBoss). Hunched ice giant ~13 tall: deep steel-blue ice slabs over a dark rock core showing through a chest cleft with a pale-cyan Neon heart (Pulse), teal crystal spikes on shoulders and back, sunk head with glowing eyes and icicle beard, huge rock fists. Legs SwingA/B, arms SwingB/A. Frost* pieces = phase-2 frost armour shell (hidden unless FrostArmor).

name: Frozen_Pond
note: Flat frozen pond ~10.4 x 9.2, 0.3 tall: snow bank, pale ice with a deeper centre and glint streaks, a few rocks. Slippery hazard visual (hazard radius ~4.4). Walkable decoration.

name: GoldCoin
note: Gold coin: one chunky faceted coin ~1.0 across x 0.22 thick, standing on its edge (face toward -Y), a raised rim and an embossed crown on both faces. Spun by the client.

name: GoldPile
note: Small pile of gold: four coins stacked a little askew with a fifth leaning on them, ~1.5 x 1.2 x 1.0; crowns on the top coin and the leaning one.

name: GrassTuft
note: Grass tuft, 1.2 x 0.8. Scatter decoration (<= 40 tris).

name: Guard_Altar
note: Ruined two-step stone altar ~6.4 x 5.6 for the guarded reward chest (chest sits on the top at the origin, top = 0.9), broken back pillars and a crimson banner with a gold crown on a pole behind. Front = -Y. Collider = the pillars and the pole only (the platform is a walkable step).

name: Hat_Bandana
note: Pirate bandana, eye patch, earring. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Beanie
note: Ninja cowl with an eye slit and a trailing headband. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Cap
note: Ranger's peaked cap with a long feather. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Crown
note: Five-point gold crown with jewels. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Halo
note: Floating ring of light. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Helmet
note: Great helm, T visor, gold bands, crimson plume. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Hood
note: Deep hood with a pointed tail. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Horns
note: Closed horned helm with angry slits. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Mitre
note: Bishop's mitre with stripe, cross and lappets. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Plume
note: Open parade helm with cheek guards and a tall brush crest. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Tophat
note: Tilted top hat with a band and buckle. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Hat_Wizard
note: Wide-brim pointed hat with a band. Origin = head-top centre (standard head).

name: Healer
note: Support bug: soft pale aphid with a round glowing belly (Pulse), two cornicles, small translucent wings (FlutterL/R) and a halo of six glowing motes above it (Spin, pivot on the halo axis). ~2.6 wide x 2.8 long x 3.1 tall incl. halo.

name: HiveMother
note: Boss. Bloated hive queen ~9 wide x 13.5 long x 6.5 tall: dark amber armoured head and thorax with a gold crown, crushing mandibles (Jaw), a huge pale banded egg-sac abdomen dragging behind (Tail = slow heave) studded with glowing amber pods (Throb), an egg at the tip, ten small legs (SwingA/B), antennae Wiggle.

name: Ice_Crystal
note: Cluster of pale ice crystals from a snowy rock, ~3 x 3.4, with a small frost glow. Collider circle; light = glow.

name: Knight
note: The reference hero: silver plate, great helm with a dark T visor and crimson plume, crimson cape with gold trim, crimson kite shield, steel longsword.

name: Lantern_Post
note: Wooden lantern post ~7 tall; the lantern hangs from an arm toward +X (Roblox -X). Warm Neon core.

name: Lava_Pool
note: Flat lava pool ~8.6 x 7.8, 0.22 tall: basalt crust rim, molten surface, drifting crust plates and small Neon hot spots. Hazard visual (hazard radius ~3.6). Walkable decoration; light = centre.

name: Lava_Ruin_Wall
note: Broken dark basalt-block wall with ash on the tops and glowing seams at its foot, 8 x 3.5 x 1.4 (length along X). Collider box.

name: Lilypads
note: Lilypad cluster with one pale bloom, ~3 x 2.6, 0.3 tall. Flat decoration for mud and water (no collider, no shadow).

name: Log
note: Fallen log, 7 long (X) x 1.4. Collider box.

name: Mage
note: Slate-blue robes and mantle, wide-brim pointed hat with a gold band, ivory beard, wooden staff with a small arcane crystal, leather belt and satchel.

name: Mite
note: Slime id. The grunt: round yellow-green beetle, dark head, amber eyes.

name: MothMatriarch
note: Boss (flies). Huge regal moth ~14 span x 9 long: ivory fur, two layers of translucent wings (slate under-wings, pale lavender fore-wings) with gold eye-spots and dark rims, a gold coronet and a crown of five feathery antennae, glowing heart (Pulse). Wings FlutterL/R, antennae Wiggle, legs SwingA/B.

name: Mud_Pool
note: Flat bog pool ~8.4 x 7.6, 0.2 tall: dark mud, wet sheen, bubbles, rim stones. Slow-zone hazard visual (hazard radius ~3.6 from the origin). Walkable decoration (no collider).

name: Mushroom
note: Cluster of three small forest mushrooms with muted crimson caps (~1.5 x 1). Decoration for tree shade.

name: Necromancer
note: Ivory skull mask under a tall black cowl with gold edging, black and gold robes, spiked bone collar and pauldrons, tall black staff crowned with a skull in a gold claw and a violet soul core.

name: Nest
note: Stationary hive mound ~5.2 wide x 4.2 tall: lumpy dirt-and-wax tiers, dark openings with waxy lips (enemies crawl out of them), a cluster of glowing amber egg pods at the base (Pulse) and a glowing crown vent (Throb). Does not move or turn.

name: Obsidian_Crystal
note: Cluster of black glassy obsidian shards with a small ember core, ~2.8 x 3.2. Collider circle; light = core.

name: PhaseMoth
note: Ghost id. Pale grey-lavender moth: translucent wings with slate eye-spots, glowing core (floats).

name: Pickup_Bomb
note: Black iron bomb with a fuse and a tiny spark, ~1.7 x 2.5.

name: Pickup_Chicken
note: Roast drumstick (heals), ~2.4 long; centred on the origin axis so it spins in place.

name: Pickup_Magnet
note: Crimson horseshoe magnet with steel tips, ~1.7 x 2.0 (stands upright).

name: Pillar
note: Broken column on a plinth, ~1.6 wide, 5 tall. Collider circle.

name: Portal
note: Stage portal: ancient horseshoe stone ring on a round rune dais, ~10.4 wide x 11 tall. Front = -Y (the game turns it to face the camera). Surface = the arcane membrane inside the ring and Glyphs = small rune lights; both are recoloured in game by portal state (idle, charging, boss, open). Collider = the two plinths; the passage between them stays open.

name: Priest
note: Ivory robes with a gold stole, mitre, golden sun staff and a small book.

name: Quicksand
note: Flat quicksand pool ~8.4 x 7.6, 0.2 tall: darker sinking centre and spiral ripples. Hazard visual (hazard radius ~3.6). Walkable decoration (no collider).

name: Ranger
note: Hooded archer: moss hood, tan dagged capelet, leather jerkin, tall longbow, quiver with crimson fletching on the back.

name: Reeds
note: Clump of reeds with three cattails, ~1.6 wide x 2.4 tall. Decoration (no collider).

name: RhinoBeetle
note: Brute id. Heavy slate-blue armoured beetle with a big ivory horn.

name: RhinoWarlord
note: Boss. Massive armoured rhino beetle ~10 wide x 13 long, horn to ~8.5, banner to ~13: dark slate shell under gold-trimmed steel battle plates, ivory horn with gold bands (Jaw = horn toss), a crimson war banner with a gold crown on a pole on its back (Tail = sway), six legs SwingA/B.

name: Rock
note: Mossy grey boulder, 4.5 x 3. Collider circle.

name: Rock_Slab
note: Flat stone slab, 4 x 0.8 x 3 (paths, stepping stones). Walkable, no collider.

name: Rock_Small
note: Small stone, ~1.5. Clutter (no collider, no shadow).

name: Rogue
note: Moss-green hooded cloak, leather armour, crimson scarf and mask, twin steel daggers.

name: Ruin_Arch
note: Landmark broken arch, ~10 x 9 x 2 (span along X). Passage 5.4 wide x 4.5 tall stays open between the piers. Collider = the two piers.

name: Ruin_Block
note: Fallen carved block, ~2.4, tilted and half sunk, with moss. Collider circle.

name: Ruin_Wall
note: Broken stone wall, 8 x 3.5 x 1.4 (length along X). Collider box.

name: Ruin_WallLow
note: Low broken wall, 6 x 1.6 x 1.2 (length along X). Collider box.

name: ScorpionQueen
note: Boss. Crimson scorpion queen: antique-gold plates and crown, huge claws, amber stinger.

name: Shot_Acid
note: Spitter's acid glob ~1.5 wide x 2.6 long: a fat round head at -Y (flight direction) pulling a wavy tapering tail toward +Y, two trailing droplets, a dark outline rim around the outline (reads by shape), tiny Neon core. Centred on the origin.

name: Shot_Arrow
note: Ranger arrow ~0.4 x 3.2: steel head at the -Y end, wooden shaft, crimson fletching. Lies along Y, centred on the origin.

name: Shot_Axe
note: Throwing axe ~1.9 x 2.3: steel bearded head at the -Y end with the bit toward +X (Roblox -X), wooden haft along Y.

name: Shot_Bolt
note: Crossbow bolt ~1.7 long: square steel head at -Y, dark wood shaft, three crimson fletches.

name: Shot_Boomerang
note: Boomerang ~2.6 x 0.95 lying flat, apex toward -Y, gold inlay.

name: Shot_Bottle
note: Holy Water flask ~1.2 x 1.65: translucent glass, Neon liquid, cork. Upright.

name: Shot_Fire
note: Low-poly fire blob ~1.3 long for fire trails: a round flame head at -Y with licks streaming back toward +Y, bright core and two orbiting embers.

name: Shot_FrostShard
note: Ice shard ~1.6 long, point at -Y: pale slate faceted crystal with ivory splinters and a small Neon frost core.

name: Shot_Hook
note: Chain hook head ~1.5 long: barbed steel hook at -Y curling back, eye ring and two chain links trailing toward +Y.

name: Shot_Knife
note: Throwing knife ~0.75 x 2.5: steel blade, gold guard, leather grip. Tip = -Y.

name: Shot_Orb
note: Arcane orb (~1.9 with sparks): Neon core in a translucent slate shell with orbiting sparks. Recoloured for Twin Orbs (gold core).

name: Shot_Potion
note: Alchemist's thrown flask ~1.2 x 1.5: translucent glass bulb, glowing green potion, brass cap, cork. Upright, centred on the origin.

name: Shot_Soul
note: Necromancer's soul skull ~1.2 x 2.2: small ivory skull with glowing eyes trailing a pale spectral wisp toward +Y. Flies toward -Y.

name: Shot_Spear
note: Thrown spear ~3 long: leaf-shaped steel tip at -Y, wooden shaft, gold collar and leather grip wrap.

name: Shot_Stinger
note: Boss stinger (~2.5 across, flat): amber Neon core, crimson barbed pinwheel, dark carapace ring.

name: Shot_Totem
note: Healing totem ~3.1 tall standing on the ground (origin = ground centre): carved wooden post with a face and small wings, gold crown cradling a green-gold glowing orb. Light = orb.

name: Shrine
note: Small mossy standing stone with a carved gold sigil, ~3 x 5 x 2. Front = -Y. Collider box.

name: Shrine_Bargain
note: Bargain shrine (benefit + trade-off): weathered, chipped standing stone on a cracked plinth with a crimson sigil plate and a gold balance-scale emblem, plus a small offering dish with a crimson ember. ~3 x 5 x 2.2. Front = -Y. Recolour Sigil / Glow. Collider box; light = ember.

name: Snow_Bush
note: Low dark shrub under a snow blanket, 3 x 1.9. Decoration (no collider).

name: Snow_Drift
note: Soft snow drift mound, ~5.4 x 3.6 x 1.1, wind crest on top. Decoration (no collider).

name: Snow_Lamp
note: Stone lantern ~4.2 tall: square post, lamp house with warm glowing windows, pyramid roof under snow. Collider circle; light = lamp.

name: Snow_Pine
note: Snow-laden pine, ~16 tall, canopy radius ~4.5: dark needles under snow blankets. Collider = trunk.

name: Snow_PineTall
note: Tall snowy pine for the tree line, ~22 tall. Collider = trunk.

name: Snow_Rock
note: Cool grey boulder with a snow blanket, ~4.6 x 3. Collider circle.

name: Snow_Ruin_Wall
note: Broken stone wall under snow with icicles, 8 x 3.6 x 1.4 (length along X). Collider box.

name: Snow_Shrine_Totem
note: Landmark carved totem ~7.6 tall on a snowy stone plinth: stacked carved wood segments with slate-blue paint, spread wings (T silhouette from above), ivory antlers, a gold sun disc and a small frost gem; slate prayer cloths. Front = -Y. Collider circle; light = gem.

name: Spitter
note: Ranged beetle: mauve shell carrying a bulbous amber acid sac (Pulse) with glowing bubbles (Throb) with a raised spout (Jaw = recoil when it spits). ~3.2 wide x 3.6 long x 3.2 tall.

name: Stump
note: Tree stump, 1.8 x 1.2. Collider circle.

name: Swamp_Hut
note: Landmark stilt hut: plank cabin on six stilts, shaggy thatch roof, front porch with a ladder (-Y) and a hanging wisp lantern, ~7.2 x 8.4 x 8.6. Collider = the stilt footprint.

name: Swamp_Lantern
note: Crooked wooden post ~5.6 tall with a hanging cage lantern and a pale-green wisp glow (toward +X, Roblox -X); moss strands. Collider circle.

name: Swamp_Log
note: Rotting log half sunk in the bog, 7 long (X) x 1.5, moss and pale shelf fungus. Collider box.

name: Swamp_Rock
note: Dark wet boulder with a moss blanket and a draping fringe, ~4.4 x 2.6. Collider circle.

name: Swamp_Stump
note: Hollow broken stump with a jagged rim, moss and shelf fungus, ~2.2 x 2.3. Collider circle.

name: Swamp_Tree
note: Gnarled mangrove on arching prop roots with a broad flat canopy and pale hanging moss, ~12 tall, canopy radius ~5. Collider = the root knot.

name: Swamp_Willow
note: Weeping willow: thick short trunk, domed crown and a curtain of drooping fronds, ~11 tall, canopy radius ~5. Collider = trunk.

name: ThornSprout
note: ThornSprout id. Briar Sentinel's summon: small thorn beetle ~2.4 wide, bark-brown shell, moss saddle, three bold bone thorns, dark head and legs, amber eyes.

name: Torch
note: Standing torch post ~5 tall with an iron fire bowl and a small flame.

name: Torch_Wall
note: Wall sconce torch. Origin = wall mount point (back plate on the wall); it projects toward -Y and the flame sits ~1.2 above the origin.

name: Tree_Pine
note: Tiered chunky pine, ~16 tall, canopy radius ~4.5. Collider = trunk.

name: Tree_PineTall
note: Tall pine for the tree line, ~22 tall. Collider = trunk.

name: Tree_Round
note: Chunky broadleaf, ~13 tall, canopy radius ~5.5. Collider = trunk.

name: Wasp
note: Bat id. Gold and black wasp with translucent ivory wings and a stinger (flies).
